mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.article_title AS title, a.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, a.publish_time AS publishTime, a.view_count AS viewCount, a.like_count AS likeCount FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.status = 1

SELECT a.id, a.article_slug AS articleSlug, a.article_title AS title, a.article_summary AS summary, a.cover_image_url AS coverUrl, a.author_id AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorName, u.avatar_url AS authorAvatar, a.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, a.is_top AS isTop, a.is_featured AS isFeatured, a.view_count AS viewCount, a.like_count AS likeCount, a.comment_count AS commentCount, a.publish_time AS publishTime FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.is_top DESC, a.publish_time DESC

SELECT at.article_id AS articleId, t.tag_name AS tagName FROM article_tag at LEFT JOIN tag t ON at.tag_id = t.id WHERE at.article_id IN
#{id}
